meta.title: Skill selector
meta.description: Independent manual mode and automatic skill allowlist per conversation. New conversations start with manual mode off and snapshot the default allowlist on first policy initialization. When on, listed skills may auto-load; others require explicit selection. Turning it off restores native behavior for this conversation. Default edits do not rewrite existing conversations. Find all effective skills by task in the current conversation right pane. Use one skill or preview a primary/helper combination. Retains ratings, notes, favorites, hidden skills and all historical records. Combined reviews do not affect individual scores. Compare in your own conversation branches; there is no dedicated comparison workflow. Includes full YouMind and original Cookbook and PromptFill sites, opened in new Chrome windows after selection. Hiding never deletes or globally disables skills.
